other_text: BLOOD-CURLING! HAIR-RAISING! SPINE-CHILLING! One bite from a giant spider turned him into the world's most hideous monster... with a biabolical lust to KILL! He strangles his victims with his mammoth claws! SO TERRIFYING SHOCKING SUSPENSE YOU'LL BE AFRAID TO GO TO SLEEP!
moderation_notes: Contains mild violent imagery and horror themes.
description: Vintage horror poster featuring a man and woman with a giant spider; bold red and black text highlights the terrifying plot.
